data.name: [WORLD 3] Become a Brainrot
data.description:
🍬🍫 CANDY & CHOCOLATE KEYBOARD EVENTS STARTS EVERY 1 HOUR AND LASTS FOR 15M

Welcome to Become a Brainrot!
In this game you get to Be your Favorite Brainrots! ✨

🏰 Go further each time you run
💤 Wait for Guards to Fall Asleep
🏃 Steal Their Brainrot and Run Back!
💸 Place Brainrots to Earn Cash!
✨Upgrade your Rarity for Better Luck!

😴 YOUR BRAINROTS EARN CASH OFFLINE! 

🔥JOIN THE GROUP FOR FREE EPIC BRAINROT!!!
